external_dependency_in_prior_gap_proof.hypotheses_and_use: Holomorphic vector bundles on the complex Riemann sphere split as direct sums of line bundles. The prior biform gap proof applies this to the constant-rank kernel bundle of its polynomial matrix; it then computes sections and obtains the rank gap. No splitting theorem is asserted over an arbitrary field.
